claims.content: To allow the Auctioneer to manage user access to the auction administration application by listing all users authorized to use it, creating or editing user profiles, and deleting users.

goal.raw_text: To allow the Auctioneer to manage user access to the auction administration application by listing all users authorized to use it, creating or editing user profiles, and deleting users.

claims.content: Auctioneer
The Auctioneer is a logged-in user of the auction administration application.
User Access Management is an option on the Administration Menu from the Auction Administration Main Menu.
The Auctioneer selects the User Access Management option from the Administration Menu on the Auction Administration Main Menu.

trigger.raw_text: The Auctioneer selects the User Access Management option from the Administration Menu on the Auction Administration Main Menu.

claims.content: The Auctioneer selects User Access Management from the Administration Menu on the Auction Administration Main Menu.
The system displays the User Access Management page with two buttons/links: List All Users and Create New User.
The Auctioneer selects List All Users.

The system displays the List All Users page, which lists all users authorized to use the auction administration application with columns including Last Name, First Name, (Job) Title, Login ID, Admin, Delete, and Edit.
The Auctioneer selects an Edit button in the Edit column.
The system takes the Auctioneer to the Create or Edit User page.
The Auctioneer selects a Delete button for a user.
The system displays a confirmation dialogue box asking the user to confirm the action, with a Yes, Delete User button and a Cancel button.
The Auctioneer confirms the action using the Yes, Delete User button.
The system deletes the user from the system.
2a. The Auctioneer selects the Create New User button/link instead of List All Users; the third User Access Management page is the Create or Edit User page.

4a. If the Auctioneer selects a Delete button instead of an Edit button, the system displays a confirmation dialogue box asking the user to confirm the action, with a Yes, Delete User button and a Cancel button.
8a. The Auctioneer selects the Cancel button, which will be RED, in the confirmation dialogue box instead of selecting the Yes, Delete User button.
The List All Users page lists all users authorized to use the auction administration application.
The List All Users page includes columns for Last Name, First Name, (Job) Title, Login ID, Admin, Delete, and Edit.
When an Edit button in the Edit column is clicked, the user is taken to the Create or Edit User page.

The Create or Edit User page displays editable fields for First Name, Last Name, Title, Email Address, Change PW, and Confirm PW; an unchecked checkbox labeled Require user to change PW on next login; and access-level radio button options for Administrator and User.
When the Auctioneer confirms deletion using the Yes, Delete User button, the user is deleted from the system.
